observations: Photo 0 shows a used car engine with a grey valve cover embossed with the KIA logo and an orange dipstick handle.
Photo 1 shows the same KIA engine from above with “DOHC 16V” visible on the valve cover, sitting on a concrete floor with a person’s feet in the frame.
Photo 2 shows the front of the KIA engine with pulleys, belts, and timing cover visible.
All three photos carry the watermark “POSTED ON JIJI JOHNKINGSLEY EBUBE”.

claims.evidence: Photos show a KIA-branded engine but cannot prove country of origin or import status.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal mechanical damage
risks.proof: Video of the engine starting and running, or a compression test result

risks.risk: Engine may be missing ancillaries, sensors, or accessories
risks.proof: Detailed photos of all sides showing the engine is complete

risks.risk: Actual mileage and internal wear cannot be verified from photos
risks.proof: Service history or engine block code/number

risks.risk: Engine may not fit the buyer’s intended vehicle
risks.proof: Clear photo of any engine code stamped on the block plus fitment details

proof_requests: Clear photo of any engine code or number stamped on the block
Photos showing the engine from all sides to confirm completeness
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a KIA car engine from the valve cover lettering in the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-running used engine.
